blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Initial tests on Jonah Sabete-Escamillan’s injured left leg came back negative, giving Nxled hope that its veteran wing spiker did not suffer a serious injury. Escamillan hurt her leg after an awkward landing midway through the third set and was stretchered off the court on Thursday during their game against Akari in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The Chameleons remained unbeaten in six games, but the victory was bittersweet for coach Ettore Guidetti.
